integrity: The proof derives the mixed covariance from the recursive growth coupling and an independently derived expectation for the sum of leaf depths. An exhaustive exact-rational checker enumerates all recursive trees through size ten. The finite replay is supplementary and is not used as the proof for arbitrary size.
scientific_limitations: The exact quarter-step covariance uses uniform recursive-tree attachment and is not asserted for weighted recursive trees or Hoppe trees.
Negative covariance does not imply negative association of the full collection of tree statistics.
Classical marginal moments are used as background; the claimed contribution is the mixed leaf-count/internal-path-length covariance and its growth-step mechanism.
title: Leaves and search cost have an exact quarter-step covariance in random recursive trees
